name: FormWav
title: local-first audio editing, repair and mixing with no account
summary: FormWav is an open-source multitrack audio editor and small music studio: record, edit, repair, mix and export on your own machine, with Claude Code inside.
lede: FormWav is an open-source audio editor that runs on your own machine: record, edit, repair, mix and export without an account, an upload or a usage meter. It is a multitrack editor and a small music studio with Claude Code inside it, working on the open session through one registry of every menu item and session tool. Its target is a measured 90% on a sourced parity scoreboard against the leading audio editors.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux, in a browser or as a Tauri 2 desktop app
checks: Mixes clips, fades, buses, VCAs, automation and realtime effects in one Rust core, in the browser's audio thread and in the export, so what plays is what renders.
Imports MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG, Opus, AIFF, WAV or a video's audio, with 200 undo steps.
Repairs on a spectrogram with box, lasso and painted selections and a Heal command.
Exports in twelve formats and reports sample peak, true peak and loudness.

facts.dd: .fmw; a saved session opens from disk in the browser
Python 3.12 and FastAPI with a Rust audio core, formwav-dsp, built into the engine as a Python module
English and 25 other languages, with 15 theme profiles and six accents
The interface and the engine bind 127.0.0.1; devices on this network are off by default and need a one-time pairing code

chapters.title: One mixer, two places
chapters.text: The Rust core mixes clips, fades, buses, VCAs, automation and realtime effects the same way in the browser and in the export. A library of studio processors covers EQ, compressor, gate, de-esser, maximizer, reverbs, modulation, drive and pitch shift.

chapters.title: Heal clicks, crackle and noise
chapters.text: The heal brush on the spectrogram paints a selection, and Heal repairs it as one undo step, for box, lasso and painted selections alike. The MCP server adds formwav_heal_selection so an agent can do the same in one explicit call.

chapters.title: Claude Code inside the session
chapters.text: The Agent column sends each message to the claude program on this computer, using your own login, and it edits through the same commands as the interface. Optional components cover transcription, stem separation, noise suppression and speech made locally.

features.title: Mixer and buses
features.text: The Rust core mixes clips, fades, buses, VCAs and automation.
bullets: A track's effects other than its filters run on its sum, so tails ring past each clip's end
A track's own bus plays into a user bus, in playback and export
What plays is what renders

features.title: Studio processors
features.text: FormWav's own processors in the audio core, live in playback and in every export.
bullets: Band EQ and a seven-band EQ, compressor with sidechain and lookahead, gate and expander
Split-band de-esser and a look-ahead maximizer
A room and a plate reverb
Chorus, flanger, phaser, drive, bit crusher and pitch shift
Gain, trim, polarity, DC block, test tone and dither

features.title: Import, edit and undo
features.text: Import or drop common formats, resampled to the session's rate.
bullets: MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG, Opus, AIFF, WAV or a video's audio
Every change is an undo step, 200 deep
Separate on the grid, Strip silence and range copy and paste

features.title: Recording
features.text: Several armed tracks record at once.
bullets: Takes are shifted by the Latency field's value, which you measure yourself
Tracks on the same device line up exactly

features.title: The interface
features.text: A header, a browser at the left, the arrangement in the middle, the editor, the Agent column and a footer.
bullets: Browser with one search over Media, Effects and Sounds
Toolbar: Add a track, Select, Split, Fade, Draw, Zoom, Fit and Follow
Main counter in Min:Secs, Timecode, Feet+Frames, Samples or Bars|Beats

features.title: Spectrogram repair
features.text: Select and heal on the spectrogram.
bullets: The brush only selects; Heal repairs the selection
Heal from a button in the Inspector, Edit > Heal selection or Alt Shift H
A clean-noises skill in the formwav-harness: find each click, box it, heal, then measure before and after

features.title: Export
features.text: Twelve formats, MP3 at two bitrates, the whole session or a range.
bullets: A dither switch and peak normalisation
A notice with sample peak, true peak and loudness
A WAV past 4 GiB is written as RF64
Renders saved sessions as a mix, 5.1 or ADM objects through MCP

features.title: Optional AI components
features.text: Each component under its own licence.
bullets: Transcription with faster-whisper and stem separation with Demucs
Noise suppression with an RNNoise model fetched on first use
Speech and dubbing on your machine with Kokoro, Pocket TTS, Chatterbox and Argos Translate's models
Isolate sound with Meta's SAM-Audio, with weights gated behind a manual access request

features.title: Generate with models
features.text: The Sounds tab makes audio and puts it on a new track.
bullets: ElevenLabs models through your own API key
ACE-Step 1.5 on your machine through its own server, or through fal
Sound effects from a description, up to 10 s (EzAudio)
Your own open-weight models through backend/models/local_models.json

features.title: Agent and MCP
features.text: Claude Code runs inside FormWav with your own Claude login, no API key.
bullets: The Agent column and the embedded terminal
An MCP server in backend/formwav_mcp with 35 formwav_* tools
Settings > Agents adds FormWav to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Claude Desktop in one click
The formwav-harness skill teaches an agent which tool fits a job

features.title: NodeMode design system
features.text: Tokens, 15 theme profiles and a pre-paint theme boot.
bullets: Zero-flash shell mounted once and patched in place
Matches FormVis surface for surface

parity.summary: No single tool is the reference, so the baseline is every capability that at least one of the fourteen has; nine of the rows are music only. FormWav was re-examined at 2.21.1, about forty releases after the 2.14.6 the v13 page graded, and six rows moved since then.

docs.install:
git clone https://github.com/nodemode-dev/formwav.git
cd formwav
./formwav_oc_install
Windows: formwav_oc_install.bat
docs.agents: An MCP server in backend/formwav_mcp; Settings > Agents adds FormWav to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Claude Desktop in one click.

topics.title: Ports
topics.text: The interface runs at http://localhost:3060 and the engine at http://127.0.0.1:8060, with health at /api/health.

topics.title: Desktop app
topics.text: ./build_macos_app builds formwav.app and a .dmg; ffmpeg and rubberband are found on your PATH and never bundled.

topics.title: Generate with models
topics.text: The README lists ElevenLabs, ACE-Step 1.5 and the local speech, dubbing and sound-effect models, and what each needs.

topics.title: Connect an agent
topics.text: The README explains the Agent column, the MCP server and the formwav-harness skill.

topics.title: Not built or not verified
topics.text: A section of the README lists what is not built or not verified yet, such as the latency measurement and the length limits of very long exports.

items: The MCP server gains formwav_heal_selection (35 tools)
A clean-noises sub-skill in the formwav-harness skill
The heal brush only paints a selection; Heal repairs it as one undo step
An optional second predictor from inside the painted run, off by default
The GPL-2.0 Nyquist plug-ins are downloaded on request instead of shipping in the app
RNNoise, speech-detection, Kokoro and translation model downloads are pinned
